evidence.note: Hand reaches the closed entry/coat-closet door handle.
Closet door is open and the closet contents are exposed.
Hand grips the closet door to close it.
Closet door is fully closed.
Hand grasps the closed microwave door handle.
Microwave door is visibly swinging open.
Microwave remains fully open.
Hand pushes the microwave door toward the frame.
Microwave door is fully closed.
Hand pulls the oven handle and the door begins lowering.
Oven door is fully open.
Oven door remains open while the user re-engages it.
Hand raises the oven door nearly shut.
Oven door is fully closed.
Hand approaches the closed dishwasher handle.
Dishwasher door is lowered open, exposing the racks.
Dishwasher remains open.
Hand lifts the dishwasher door toward closed.
Dishwasher door is fully closed.
Hand reaches the seam of the closed upper cabinet above the sink.
The left member of the double-door cabinet is swinging outward.
Both cabinet doors are open and the shelves are exposed.
Both doors remain open shortly before closure.
Hand completes closure and the cabinet fronts are aligned.

events.object_description: Left door of double-door upper cabinet above sink

evidence.note: Both doors of the cabinet appear closed as the hand reaches their central seam.
The right cabinet door is also visibly displaced outward as the cabinet opens.
Right door is clearly open beside the exposed shelves.
Right door remains open.
Cabinet is closed after a rapid two-door closure action.

events.object_description: Right door of double-door upper cabinet above sink

evidence.note: Hand pulls the flush-front drawer beside the refrigerator.
Drawer is open with stored boxes and cloth visible.
Drawer remains extended.
Drawer is fully retracted and flush with the cabinetry.
Hand pulls the upper refrigerator handle.
Upper refrigerator door is open and interior light is visible.
Refrigerator remains open immediately before closure.
Hand swings the upper door shut.
Upper refrigerator door is fully closed.
Hand pulls the lower freezer handle.
Lower freezer door is open and illuminated drawers are visible.
Hand begins pushing the freezer door closed.
Lower freezer door is fully closed.
Laundry-closet door is closed immediately before manipulation.
Door has opened, revealing the stacked washer and dryer.
Hand grips the open door and pulls it shut.
Laundry-closet door is fully closed.

notes: Ten movable-part episodes are reported. The paired upper-cabinet doors are counted separately under the instruction that distinct movable parts should not be merged, although their individual manipulations occur within the same short sampling interval and therefore have lower confidence.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a studio apartment, primarily around the entry, compact kitchen, refrigerator, and laundry closet. The user sequentially opens and later closes doors, appliances, a cabinet pair, and a drawer.
